findings.claim: Both source models contain nine active outer RNA instances with 4641 nodes and 7209 S3/S4R elements. Detailed mesh assets exist.
findings.evidence: final report models.*.outer_instances; primary/explicit nodes and elements CSV

findings.claim: The frozen source CAE reported exactly two model names, both exported. The second is RNA_REAL_EXPLICIT and has a one-second ExplicitDynamicsStep and a VelocityBC with global vr3=1 rad/s.

All three outer Part types show active BeamSection assignments to SET_ALL_FACE, using a circular radius 0.01 mass-carrier profile and artificial densities. The script did not expand assignment regions to element coverage or enumerate compositeLayups.

Each blade and spinner coupling selects every node of that outer instance and is active KINEMATIC with all six DOFs. If this configuration is retained and accepted by input processing, those clouds follow rigid motion and do not retain independent elastic blade deformation.
findings.evidence: CSV set equality plus models.*.couplings settings

findings.claim: V1 expanded the tower-face region using adjacent-element nodes (96); V2 uses Face.getNodes (48). The correction did not change full-blade node membership.

Nacelle couplings use SET_TOWER_TOP as controlPoint; the old resolved region contains a tower face and 48 nodes, not a reference point. This needs actual input validation and must not be silently treated as a proper single RP.

The earlier consistency-checked writeInput failed for the primary model due to missing beam orientations on the three surface Parts. It was not a submitted solver job and was not an export attempt for RNA_REAL_EXPLICIT.
The original RNA mass skeleton Part has 32 nodes and 28 B31 elements; the source instance and RB_RNA_DISTRIBUTED_OFFICIAL are suppressed. Instance zero nodes do not mean the Part has no mesh.

These records do not establish that no usable model exists in any other CAE, that no rotation was ever simulated, or that all historical jobs failed. Auxiliary model copy omitted historical jobs/custom data; the old intake also had a job repository read error.
findings.evidence: recovery_method plus intake error; no solver submit in final export

findings.claim: Detailed outer mesh and an existing rotation branch are proven; a validated deformable/rotating RNA response is not established by this export, and the recorded section/whole-surface coupling configuration presents concrete obstacles.
